name: Passport Application
description: Guidance for Bhutanese citizens applying for an ordinary passport.
eligibility: Bhutanese citizens are eligible to apply for a passport.
procedure: Visit the official Bhutan G2C Citizen Services Portal.
Follow the official online application instructions.
Check the Ministry of Foreign Affairs guidance for the applicable requirements and fees.
important_note: Requirements and fees may change. Confirm the latest information with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs before applying.
source: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and External Trade

name: Birth and Death Registration
description: Guidance for accessing birth and death registration services in Bhutan.
eligibility: Refer to the official Department of Civil Registration and Census guidance for applicable eligibility.
procedure: Visit the Bhutan G2C Citizen Services Portal.
Locate the relevant birth or death registration service.
Follow the official instructions for accessing the service.
The Department of Civil Registration and Census announced nationwide availability through the Integrated Citizen Services platform using Bhutan NDI.
Consult the official department for current document requirements and further instructions.
important_note: Confirm current requirements and eligibility with the Department of Civil Registration and Census.
source: Department of Civil Registration and Census
